artifacts.summary: All 8 phases completed: production checker resolver and capability handshake, the verify-setting output gate with three honest states, the test-helper refactor onto the production resolver, gate documentation, a fresh trimmed-binary measurement confirming the out-of-band packaging route, and the item-3 ledger/direction-claim extensions across seven surfaces.
All 8 phase headings marked [COMPLETED]; plan-level Status field updated to [COMPLETED].

next_steps: Task complete. Two findings deferred to the certificate-wire hardening task (see summary's Follow-ups): ADEQUACY.md section 6.2 / TRUST_PIPELINE.md's trust-base 'kernel-checked proof for that particular certificate' overclaim, and whether BIMODAL_LOGIC_COMMIT should track the companion repository automatically. A structural-conformance-check follow-on was recorded (not built) in TRUST_PIPELINE.md's remaining-work table, explicitly sequenced after items 1-2 as UNSAT-direction work.
notes: Full project gate green (645 passed, 5 skipped, code/tests/) and bimodal suite green both with and without a resolvable checker (629 passed solo-with-checker; 612 passed/17 skipped without). One collision was found and fixed during Phase 3: BimodalSemantics must not set an attribute literally named 'verify' (models/semantic.py and iterate/models.py both use hasattr(semantics, 'verify') as a theory-capability test) -- the resolved attribute is self.verify_mode instead, settings key unaffected. Phase 6's companion-repo measurement (supportInterpreter=false) halved the compressed checker artifact (~65.9MiB -> ~32.8MiB) but it stays in the tens of MiB, so the out-of-band opt-in route (Phases 1-5) is confirmed as the recommendation, not in-wheel shipping; the companion repo's lakefile and build artifact were both restored to baseline afterward.
